# Evidence through change: candidates propagated through every admitted change

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`evidence-through-change` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F05 · [record](evidence-through-change.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every lawful history of readings, admitted changes and responses keeps the actual world among the possible ones once it is there, so a certificate over their pooled models stays sound; predicting a change can reopen excluded alternatives, and an understated change can leave false confidence.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A reading keeps every world that fits it, so the actual world, fitting its own report, is kept; prediction of an admitted change keeps every lawful successor of a possible world. Along every lawful history, from a state whose possible worlds hold the actual one and lie among the represented worlds, the finish has the same. (`TemporalInspection.received_actual_retained`, `TemporalInspection.prediction_contains_successor`, `TemporalInspection.Known`, `TemporalInspection.lawful_history_preserves_known`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
2. A certificate over the pool of the possible worlds' models then warrants, for the causes acting on commands, whatever every faithful domain outside those causes warrants, at every lawful finish. (`TemporalInspection.current_pool_sound`, `TemporalInspection.history_to_current_certificate`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
3. Witnesses: after a scan leaves two models, predicting a reset reopens all three and the certificate that passed fails; a control change after the last report reopens all three; a change recorded as steady when the world moved leaves the actual world outside the possible ones, the certificate passing on compromised support while the audit fails. (`TemporalInspection.predicting_change_reopens_relevant_alternatives`, `TemporalInspection.new_change_after_last_report_reopens_coverage`, `TemporalInspection.understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
4. Over the reals, an intervention certified from a reading with symmetric error E keeps the end within the target [L, B] wherever the actual value lies within E of the reading, and needs 2E ≤ B − L; with error growing as σ + ρt it needs 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ. (`ChangingDependency.certified`, `ChangingDependency.certificate_transfers`, `ChangingDependency.uncertainty_requires_tolerance`, `ChangingDependency.error_growth_budget`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The worlds, the admitted changes and their successors, the reporting law and the faithfulness of diagnostics are supplied; recording, local atomic steps and command execution are protected.
- For the bound, the error model σ + ρt and an additive intervention bounded by what is left are supplied, over the real numbers (Mathlib).
- Axioms: in TemporalInspection received_actual_retained and the understated-change witness use propext, the prediction and history laws propext and Quot.sound, the reset and control witnesses none; the ChangingDependency declarations use propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice, as their receipts report.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the admitted changes are the actual ones: the transition relation is supplied, not inferred from a notice or a clock.
- Physical recovery or legitimacy: a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant.
- That a certificate which passes is sound when a change is understated: the actual world can fall outside the possible ones. Witness: `TemporalInspection.understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence`.
- **Counterexample:** A movement recorded as steady: the actual world leaves the possible ones, the certificate passes on supports the actual faults include, and the audit fails (understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence).
